gates.rule: All 17 navigation sections render and route to a non-placeholder functional surface.
Every visible mutating action maps to one canonical operationBinding or is explicitly FORBIDDEN and absent in production.
Every relevant blocked action renders disabled reason; no unexplained disabled primary action.
No client-only success: mutating success requires persisted canonical outcome/postcondition.
stateVersion/revision/binding/epoch conflict renders CONFLICT, refreshes canonical snapshot and does not blind retry.
All text controls follow declared input profile and preserve content without silent truncation; server schema remains authoritative.
Each page proves loading, empty, error, stale/reconnecting, ready and success/terminal states applicable to its contract.
Responsive tests pass at 390x844, 768x1024, 1366x768 and 1920x1080 without unintended page-level horizontal scroll.
Keyboard-only traversal can reach every action, editor, table control, modal/drawer and browser collaboration tool.
Screen-reader labels, disabled reasons, validation errors and live operation states are announced.
Generation has no bypass blocking-gate action anywhere in page, command palette, context menu, chat projection or API-generated action UI.
Security UI has no application password-change control and no user/role/group/permission management surface.
OPENAI_CONFIGURATION_REQUIRED disables only AI-dependent actions and leaves non-AI administration operational.
Browser MARKUP never forwards pointer/touch input to page; BROWSE input requires current control lease.
Stale Browser target/annotation/document identity never silently rebinds to similar content.
OWNER takeover/return-AI controls reflect server control lease and reject stale epoch before page input dispatch.
Secrets reveal/copy/rotate/bind/version flows expose real canonical state and reserved OWNER API key restrictions.
Configuration SYSTEM_MANAGED values are read-only with derivation/source explanation; OWNER-editable values use desired/effective lifecycle.
Audit/log UI can correlate a mutating UI operation to logicalOperationId/correlationId and canonical audit event.
Object actions are parity-tested across detail, table, dashboard, search, command palette, alert/audit relation views where semantically applicable.
Double-click/double-submit does not create duplicate business effect; UI disables pending action and server idempotency proves same logical outcome.
Cancel before/after possible side effect follows operation reconciliation and never renders false CANCELLED/SUCCESS.
MANUAL_REVIEW blocks automatic retries and presents evidence plus exact OWNER next actions.
All tables have sticky header where specified, bounded internal horizontal scroll for wide data and column chooser without losing row identity.
All modal/drawer destructive actions require declared confirmation level and return focus to invoker after close.
Empty states expose one primary recovery/create action only when the action registry says it is valid.
All file/attachment/upload controls surface size/type/schema validation and deterministic failure without partial domain mutation.
Live SSE/WSS reconnect restores from server snapshot/cursor and labels stale data until freshness is confirmed.
Presentation/secret-hiding mode changes only presentation and never stored logs/audit/API payload semantics.
No placeholder, mock, dead button, local fake action, TODO-only surface or demo-only route exists in production UI.
